description: notesOnly without consent: nothing is sent.

error.detail: mode notesOnly replaces every note of the clip, including notes edited by hand, and cannot be undone; replace_edited_notes was not true

nextStep.message: Tell the user that notesOnly replaces all notes of the clip and cannot be undone. Only after the user explicitly agrees, call again with replace_edited_notes: true. dry_run: true previews it safely.
